items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Tommy in the context of discussing other musicians (Al Kahan, Shad Collins, Jack Teagarden) and Tommy's respect for black trombone players, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with Tommy.

ctx.x: And, of course, Tommy, he was a playboy and life got him and of course he died. Then came Al Killian Kahan. Al Kahan had a lip that was

unbelievable. I worked with him in Don Redman's band.
And, of course, Shad Collins. Shad Collins was, to me, an underrated trumpet player.
